name: Killing Blow
description: On a natural 6 to wound, the attack inflicts instant death regardless of armour.

name: Strength Potion
description: +1 Strength for the first round of combat.

name: Toughness Potion
description: +1 Toughness for the first round of combat.

name: Talisman of Protection
description: Grants a 5+ ward save (keeps a better innate ward).

name: Talisman of Preservation
description: Grants a 4+ ward save (keeps a better innate ward).

name: Berserker Brooch
description: +1 Strength in all rounds of combat.

name: Potion of Speed
description: +1 Attack for one round of combat.

name: Helm of Confusion
description: Reroll failed hit rolls in the first round of combat.

name: Potion of Strength
description: Reroll failed wound rolls in the first round of combat.

name: Immortal Fury
description: Hatred: reroll all failed hit rolls in every round.

name: Blasted Standard
description: Hits from this character ignore armour saves entirely (AP -100).

name: Regeneration (4+)
description: Regeneration (4+): a 4+ save against each unsaved wound, taken after armour. Does not stack with a ward save; the better of the two is used.

name: Enchanted Shield
description: Improves armour save by an additional +1 (stacks with shield).

name: Poisoned Attacks
description: On a natural 6 to hit, the attack automatically wounds with no roll needed.
